description: This file defines string splitting functions and related delimiter and predicate classes for the Abseil C++ library, including the main `StrSplit()` function and various delimiter types like `ByString`, `ByChar`, `ByAnyChar`, `ByLength`, and `MaxSplits`. It also includes predicates for filtering split results such as `AllowEmpty`, `SkipEmpty`, and `SkipWhitespace`.

classes.name: ByString
classes.description: Delimiter class for splitting strings by a substring.

classes.name: ByChar
classes.description: Delimiter class for splitting strings by a single character.

classes.name: ByAnyChar
classes.description: Delimiter class for splitting strings by any of a set of characters.

classes.name: ByLength
classes.description: Delimiter class for splitting strings into fixed-length segments.

classes.name: strings_internal::MaxSplitsImpl
classes.description: Internal class implementing a delimiter that limits the number of splits.

methods.name: absl::StrSplit
methods.description: Main function to split strings based on a delimiter, returning a collection of split parts.

methods.name: MaxSplits
methods.description: Factory function to create a delimiter that limits the number of splits.
